card.name: The letters ear starting a word
card.fires_on: The piece "ear" (any case) at the start of a word or name, as in earlier, early, earworm, Earhart, Earthing, or the body part ear in ear/nose/throat.

modes.label: Start of a longer word
modes.description: "Ear" opens a word like early, earlier, Earhart, Earthing or earworm.

modes.label: Ear as body part
modes.description: "Ear" or "Ears" names the organ, often in ENT terms.

card.plain: It lights up when text contains the letters "ear" starting a word, whether the word is early, Earhart, or the ear itself.
